estimates.assumptions: Standard medium carrot is ~62g; 2 chopped carrots total ~124g edible portion (raw, peeled).
½ tsp ground cumin weighs ~1g (standard density for ground spices).
Standard vegetable stock cube is ~11g; calories estimated from typical dry bouillon composition (no water added in recipe).
1 medium butternut squash (edible chopped flesh only, skin/seeds discarded) averages ~500g; matches given raw calorie density.

Couscous is listed as 'steamed' to serve alongside; realistic modest single-serving equivalent of ~65g dry (yields ~200g steamed/cooked weight) using given dry calorie density (water adds no calories).
'Chopped' parsley is a garnish/to taste; modest handful is ~5g fresh leaves.
